notes:
v4.6.91 — Min-positions now per-broker AND actually used + perf/allocation fixes

🎯 MIN POSITIONS (both reported issues)
• Per-broker: the floor is now stored separately for Alpaca vs IBKR — setting Day-bot to 1 on Alpaca no longer changes IBKR.
• Actually enforced: custom/AI bots (e.g. your energy bot) now DEPLOY into their best held-back candidates each cycle to reach the floor, instead of ignoring it. The setting syncs to the cloud per broker, so cloud bots honor it too. LONG bot also reads the per-broker value.
  (Note: the built-in DAY and SHORT bots manage positions differently — full min-positions wiring for those is a follow-up.)

⚡ ALSO INCLUDED (from the perf/allocation pass)
• Big lag/freeze fix: the bot log box is capped (was unbounded) and cloud polling is lighter (60s, small log tail).
• Removing a bot resets its lifetime baseline, so re-allocating it no longer shows the new grant as 'profit'.
• Tools → IBKR shows each bot's LIVE value/share, auto-refreshing every 30s, plus the live allocated $ total.

Update via the in-app banner.
